Why Study in Jeonju?

전주에서 공부하면 좋은 점

Seoul is exciting, but many students say the best years of their life were in Jeonju. 전주에서 공부해요! Here is why.

Quick facts 기본 정보

Wherethe center of 전북특별자치도 jeonbuk teukbyeoljachido, in the southwest of Korea
Your school전주대학교 jeonjudaehakgyo, JJ University, “the place for superstars”
Known forfood, the Hanok Village, hanji paper, pansori, the film festival
Sizeabout 640,000 people: a real city, but never too crowded
To Seoulabout 1 hour 40 minutes by KTX

Real Korea, every day

In Jeonju, old Korea is not in a museum. You walk past tiled roofs, eat in 60-year-old soup restaurants and hear 판소리 pansori at a festival.

You learn Korean culture just by living here.

Learn Korean faster

In Seoul it is easy to live in English. In Jeonju people speak Korean with you every day: at the market, on the bus, at the café.

Shop owners are patient and kind. When you try Korean, they smile and say 한국말 잘하네! hangungmal jalhane

Easy on your wallet

Rent, food and transport cost less than in Seoul. A full Korean meal with many side dishes costs about the same as a fast-food set in Seoul.

You can save money and still eat the best food in Korea.

Safe and comfortable

Jeonju is calm and safe, day and night. Buses go everywhere in the city, and the mountains and the sea are close for weekend trips.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

At JJ University you are not one student in a crowd. Professors know your name, the English track gives you classes in English, and the International Office helps you from your first day. The Hanok Village is about 20 minutes away by taxi.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

저는 전주대학교 유학생이에요.
I am an international student at Jeonju University.
전주가 정말 좋아요.
I really like Jeonju.
Learn more더 알아보기

Study and travel 공부하면서 여행하기

From Jeonju you can reach Seoul, Busan, the West Sea and big mountains in 1 to 3 hours. Many students travel every month.

Make Korean friends 한국 친구 사귀기

Join a club 동아리 dongari, a language exchange or a buddy program at school. Jeonju people are known as warm and friendly.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Telling someone where you study
전주에서 공부하고 있어요.
I'm studying in Jeonju.
When someone asks if you like it
네, 음식도 맛있고 사람들도 친절해요.
Yes, the food is good and the people are kind.

Jeonbuk State

전북특별자치도

Quick facts 기본 정보

Full name전북특별자치도 jeonbuk teukbyeoljachido
Jeonbuk State (since January 2024)
Short name전북 jeonbuk: “north 전라도 jeollado”
Main city전주 jeonju: the province office is here
Cities and counties14: 6 cities and 8 counties
Peopleabout 1.7 million

A special province

In 2024 전라북도 jeollabukdo became 전북특별자치도 jeonbuk teukbyeoljachido, a “special self-governing province”. It can make more of its own plans for farming, culture and new industry.

6 cities

전주 jeonju, 군산 gunsan (port), 익산 iksan (KTX station, Baekje history), 정읍 jeongeup, 남원 namwon, 김제 gimje (rice fields).

8 counties

완주 wanju, 진안 jinan, 무주 muju, 장수 jangsu, 임실 imsil (cheese), 순창 sunchang (gochujang), 고창 gochang, 부안 buan.

Each one has its own famous food and festival.

The land of taste

The 전라도 jeollado area is famous all over Korea for food. Koreans say: “In Jeolla, even a small restaurant is good.”

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Jeonju is the heart of Jeonbuk, so from JJ University every place in the province is an easy day trip.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

전북은 음식이 맛있기로 유명해요.
Jeonbuk is famous for its delicious food.
임실은 치즈가 유명해요.
Imsil is famous for cheese.
Learn more더 알아보기

Local products 지역 특산물

임실 치즈 imsil chijeu, 순창 고추장 sunchang gochujang, 고창 복분자 gochang bokbunja (black raspberry), 무주 반딧불 사과 muju bandeutbul sagwa.

Do not mix up 헷갈리지 마세요

전북 jeonbuk (north) and 전남 jeonnam (south) are two different provinces. 전라도 jeollado means both.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Saying where you live
저는 전북 전주에 살아요.
I live in Jeonju, Jeonbuk.

The City of Jeonju

전주라는 도시

Quick facts 기본 정보

Name全州 “the complete, whole town”: 온전한 고을 onjeonhan goeul
Peopleabout 640,000
Districts완산구 wansangu and 덕진구 deokjingu
Historymore than 1,000 years as a main city
Nickname맛의 도시 maseui dosi “city of taste”, 한옥의 도시 hanogui dosi

An old capital

Around the year 900, Jeonju was the capital of 후백제 hubaekje (Later Baekje).

Later the family of 조선 joseon's kings came from Jeonju, so the city was called the hometown of the royal family.

Old and new together

Downtown you find the old gate, the Hanok Village and markets. A few minutes away there are new apartments, cafés, cinemas and a big department store.

A city of culture

Jeonju has the film festival, a sound festival, hanji paper, and many small galleries. UNESCO named it a City of Gastronomy.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

JJ University is part of this city: city buses run between campus and downtown, and students go out to eat, shop and see movies all the time.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

전주는 천 년이 넘은 도시예요.
Jeonju is a city more than 1,000 years old.
전주 사람들은 친절해요.
People in Jeonju are kind.
Learn more더 알아보기

What does 고을 mean? 고을

고을 goeul is an old word for a town. You will see it in names like 전주 고을 jeonju goeul and in festival posters.

Jeonju's symbols 전주의 상징

The ginkgo tree 은행나무 eunhaengnamu and the hanok roof are symbols of the city.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Recommending Jeonju
전주에 꼭 한번 와 보세요.
You should come to Jeonju once.

Nature and Seasons of Jeonbuk

전북의 자연과 사계절

Quick facts 기본 정보

Plains호남평야 honampyeongya: the biggest plain in Korea, full of rice fields
Mountains덕유산 deogyusan, 내장산 naejangsan, 마이산 maisan, part of 지리산 jirisan
Seathe West Sea 서해 seohae: islands, sunsets and wide mud flats
World heritage고창 갯벌 gochang gaetbeol: the Gochang tidal flats (UNESCO)
Big project새만금 방조제 saemangeum bangjoje: a 33.9 km sea wall, one of the longest in the world

Spring 봄

Cherry blossoms 벚꽃 beotkkot cover the streets in early April. 마이산 maisan and many riversides turn pink.

Summer 여름

Hot and wet, with the rainy season 장마 jangma in July. The lotus pond in 덕진공원 deokjingongwon blooms, and the beaches open.

Autumn 가을

The best season. 내장산 naejangsan is one of the most famous places for red leaves 단풍 danpung in Korea. The rice fields turn gold.

Winter 겨울

Cold but bright. The west side gets snow, and you can ski at 무주 muju on 덕유산 deogyusan.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Every season gives you a new weekend trip. Many students go to see the autumn leaves at Naejangsan with friends from class.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

단풍 보러 내장산에 가요.
I'm going to Naejangsan to see the autumn leaves.
전주는 봄에 벚꽃이 예뻐요.
Jeonju has beautiful cherry blossoms in spring.
Learn more더 알아보기

Mud flat fun 갯벌 체험

At the seaside you can try 갯벌 체험 gaetbeol cheheom: digging for clams in the mud. Bring clothes that can get dirty!

Weather app 날씨 앱

Check fine dust 미세먼지 misemeonji in spring. On bad days, wear a mask.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Planning a trip
이번 주말에 단풍 구경 갈래요?
Shall we go see autumn leaves this weekend?

The Star Center

스타센터

The heart of JJ University's campus, and the place where many English-track classes meet.

Quick facts 기본 정보

Opened2011
Size4 floors above ground and 2 below, about 34,600 m² inside
Designed byHong Kong architect Aaron Tan, with a Korean design team
Insidelibrary, lecture rooms, student service center, career center, food court, sports facilities
온누리홀 onnuri hola big hall for ceremonies, concerts and events

A building for everything

You can take a class, study in the library, get help with student papers, eat lunch in the food court and work out, all without leaving the Star Center.

Library 도서관

The library sits in the middle of campus, so it is easy to come between classes. Find a quiet seat, borrow books or meet your study group.

Lydia Center 루디아선교센터

Inside the library is the 루디아선교센터 rudia seongyosenteo, a bright room with big windows, sofas, long tables and walls of books. It is a place for sharing, fellowship and faith activities, and also a lounge where library users can rest.

Many students come here to read, meet friends or take a break between study sessions.

Events 행사

Ceremonies, special lectures and concerts happen in 온누리홀 onnuri hol. Watch for posters: international student events are held here too.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

On your first day, find your classroom in the Star Center and walk around once. It will be your second home on campus.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

스타센터에서 수업이 있어요.
I have a class in the Star Center.
푸드코트에서 점심 먹을까요?
Shall we have lunch at the food court?
Learn more더 알아보기

Finding rooms 강의실 찾기

Room numbers show the floor first: 301호 sambaegilho is on the 3rd floor.

Star everywhere 스타

JJ University calls itself “the place for superstars”. The Star Center, Star Tower and Star Home all carry the star.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Asking the way
스타센터가 어디예요?
Where is the Star Center?
Meeting a friend
스타센터 앞에서 만나요.
Let's meet in front of the Star Center.

Star Garden and the Azaleas

스타정원과 철쭉꽃밭

Jeonju people come to JJ University just to see the flowers. You can see them every day.

Quick facts 기본 정보

스타정원 seuta jeongwonan eco-friendly garden on campus, made for the university's 55th anniversary
Flowersmoss phlox 꽃잔디 kkotjandi, azaleas 진달래 jindallae and 철쭉 cheoljjuk, daisies, rapeseed flowers
Best timeApril and May
Nightlights at night, so you can walk there after class
Open tostudents and local people: walking paths, benches and tables

A garden for everyone

Star Garden turned empty land into a garden full of flowers and walking paths. On spring weekends, hundreds of local families and students come to walk and take photos.

Azaleas 철쭉꽃밭

In late April, the whole slope below the main building 대학본관 daehak bongwan turns bright red with 철쭉 cheoljjuk, right next to the sports field. It is the most famous photo spot at JJ University.

Cherry blossom roads 벚꽃길

Before the azaleas, cherry blossoms 벚꽃 beotkkot line the roads around 진리관 jinrigwan, 자유관 jayugwan and 평화관 pyeonghwagwan.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Between classes, take your lunch or coffee to Star Garden. Many international students say this is when they first fell in love with Korean spring.

Good to know 알아 두면 좋아요

Flowers come and go fast: cherry blossoms last about a week, so don't wait for the weekend!

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

철쭉이 활짝 피었어요.
The azaleas are in full bloom.
스타정원에서 사진 찍자!
Let's take pictures at Star Garden!
Learn more더 알아보기

Flower names 꽃 이름

개나리 gaenari (yellow, March) → 벚꽃 beotkkot (white-pink, early April) → 철쭉 cheoljjuk (pink-red, late April–May).

Photo manners 사진 예절

Don't step into the flower beds for photos, and keep the garden clean.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Inviting a friend
수업 끝나고 꽃 보러 갈래요?
Want to go see the flowers after class?

벚꽃 beotkkotcherry blossom
피다 pidato bloom

The Campus in Dramas

드라마 속 캠퍼스

Have you seen JJ University on Netflix without knowing it? Korean dramas love this campus.

Quick facts 기본 정보

그해 우리는 (Our Beloved Summer)campus scenes and the tree-lined road from the back gate
소년심판 (Juvenile Justice)the university's main office building was used as the court
우리 사랑했을까 (Was It Love?)cherry blossom roads by 진리관, 자유관 and 평화관
선산 (The Bequeathed)scenes at the art building and student union building

Why film here?

The campus has everything: modern buildings like the Star Center, classic buildings on a hill, long tree-lined roads and seasons full of flowers.

The main building 대학본관

It stands on the highest point of campus, with white columns that look grand in photos. It was the old central library; today the president's office and the main university offices are here.

In spring it is surrounded by azaleas, and many students take graduation photos in front of it.

Back-gate road 후문 가로수길

The road of tall trees near the back gate became famous from a romantic drama. It is beautiful in every season, especially in autumn.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Watch one of these dramas with your Korean friends, then find the same spots on campus. It is great listening practice, and a fun walk!

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

이 드라마를 우리 학교에서 찍었대요.
They say this drama was filmed at our school.
여기가 드라마에 나온 곳이에요.
This is the place from the drama.
Learn more더 알아보기

Drama Korean 드라마로 공부하기

Watch with Korean subtitles. Pause, repeat a line out loud and write down 3 new words each episode.

Filming on campus 촬영

If you see 촬영 중 chwaryeong jung (filming in progress), stay quiet and don't take photos of the actors without permission.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Recommending a drama
이 드라마 꼭 보세요!
You have to watch this drama!

촬영 chwaryeongfilming
장면 jangmyeonscene

Three Huts in the Forest

숲속 초막 셋

A tiny chapel that won an architecture prize, hidden on the forest path between Star Garden and the main building.

Quick facts 기본 정보

Name숲속 초막 셋 supsok chomak set “three huts in the forest”, also called 초막교회 chomakgyohoe
What is it?a very small chapel (about 20 m²) made of three joined huts
Whereon the path from 스타정원 seuta jeongwon up to 대학본관 daehak bongwan
Built2020, designed by Professor Kim Jun-young of JJ University's architecture department
PrizeGold Prize, Jeonbuk Architecture Culture Awards
Open tostudents and local people, at any time

Three huts, three doors

The idea comes from a Bible story (Matthew 17:4) about three shelters. The three pointed roofs stand for Jesus, Moses and Elijah.

Each of the three doors is both an entrance and a path: you can walk right through the chapel on your way across campus.

Materials 재료

Outside, the walls are rust-colored steel 코르텐 강판 koreuten gangpan, which grows darker and richer with time. Inside, the concrete walls show the pattern of wood grain.

A quiet place

JJ University is a Christian university, but the chapel is open to everyone. Sit for a few minutes, rest from busy classes and listen to the forest.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

On a spring walk through Star Garden, follow the path up to the three huts. It is one of the calmest places on campus, and a favorite photo spot for architecture lovers.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

작은 교회가 정말 예뻐요.
The little church is really pretty.
여기서 잠깐 쉬어 가요.
Let's rest here for a moment.
Learn more더 알아보기

Architecture tour 건축 산책

Star Center (2011) and the three huts (2020) are two very different landmarks on one campus. Compare the big modern building and the tiny chapel!

Manners 예절

People may be praying inside. Speak quietly and don't block the doors with photos.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Asking the way
초막교회가 어디에 있어요?
Where is the hut chapel?

Places to Study and Rest

공부하고 쉬는 곳

Between classes, where do you go? JJ University has comfortable corners all over campus.

Quick facts 기본 정보

해치라운지 haechi raunjia student lounge in 진리관 jinrigwan with sofas, round tables and bookshelves
도서관 doseogwanthe library in the 스타센터 seuta senteo: reading rooms and quiet seats
해동학술정보실 haedong haksul jeongbosila study room in the engineering building 공학관 gonghakgwan
루디아선교센터 rudia seongyosenteoa bright lounge with books, inside the library
스타정원 seuta jeongwonbenches and tables outdoors, in the garden

Hatch Lounge 해치라운지

Soft armchairs, round tables, long desks and a wall of books. Students come here to do homework on a tablet, read, or wait for the next class with friends.

Haedong study room 해동학술정보실

In the engineering building 공학관 gonghakgwan, this study room has long wooden tables, glass-walled rooms for groups and a warm wooden ceiling. A calm place to focus before exams.

Free period 공강

A gap between two classes is called 공강 gonggang. Use it to review your Korean, eat a snack or take a short rest in a lounge.

Group work 조별 과제

For team projects 조별 과제 jobyeol gwaje, the big tables in lounges and in the library are perfect for meeting your group.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Find your favorite spot in your first week: one quiet place to study and one place to relax with friends.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

공강 시간에 라운지에서 쉬어요.
I rest in the lounge during my free period.
여기 자리 있어요?
Is this seat taken?
Learn more더 알아보기

Lounge manners 라운지 예절

Talk quietly, take your trash with you, and don't keep seats with your bag for a long time.

Charging 충전

Look for power outlets 콘센트 konsenteu near the tables to charge your laptop or phone.

Say it like this 이럴 때 이렇게 말해요

Meeting your group
해치라운지에서 만나요.
Let's meet at the Hatch Lounge.
Asking for a seat
여기 앉아도 돼요?
May I sit here?

쉬다 swidato rest

Jeonju Hanok Village

전주 한옥마을

Quick facts 기본 정보

What is it?a village of more than 700 traditional Korean houses, right in the city center
Where풍남동 pungnamdong and 교동 gyodong, next to the old south gate
Visitorsabout 10 million a year, one of the most visited places in Korea
Insidecafés, restaurants, craft shops, museums and hanok guesthouses
Pricefree to walk around

Walk in hanbok

Rent a 한복 hanbok for a few hours and walk the stone alleys 골목 golmok. People in hanbok get free entry to some palaces and sites in Korea, including 경기전 gyeonggijeon.

Sleep in a hanok

In a hanok guesthouse 한옥 스테이 hanok seutei you sleep on a thick mattress on a warm floor 온돌 ondol. It is a favorite experience for visiting family and friends.

Taste and make

Try street food, make your own hanji fan or try traditional tea. Many workshops welcome foreigners.

Best views

Climb up to 오목대 omokdae at sunset to see a sea of black tile roofs. At night the lanterns come on.

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

About 20 minutes from campus by taxi, and also by city bus. When friends or family visit you in Korea, this is the first place to take them.

Good to know 알아 두면 좋아요

Go early in the morning on weekdays: the village is quiet and the light is beautiful for photos.

Useful sentences 이렇게 말해요

한복 빌리는 데 얼마예요?
How much is it to rent a hanbok?
한옥에서 하룻밤 자 보고 싶어요.
I want to try sleeping one night in a hanok.
Learn more더 알아보기

Hanok guide 한옥 구조

Look for 기와 giwa (roof tiles), 마루 maru (wooden floor hall), 마당 madang (yard) and 담 dam (wall).

Free museums 무료 박물관

Several small museums in the village, like the wine and craft museums, are free or very cheap.

Hometown of kings

Jeonju was the hometown of the royal family. That is why the city has a royal shrine and a special name in Korean history.

How Jeonju saved history

In 1592 a war burned the other copies of the Annals. Only the Jeonju copy survived: two local scholars carried the books into the mountains of Naejangsan and protected them.

Thanks to Jeonju, we can still read 500 years of Joseon history.

Walk back in time

In the early 1900s, rice from the plains was shipped from Gunsan to Japan. Old banks, houses and a temple from that time still stand. The city tells this sad history honestly.

Jeonju Dialect

전주 사투리

Quick facts 기본 정보

Dialect사투리 saturi: the local way of speaking
Jeolla dialect전라도 사투리 jeollado saturi: warm, friendly and full of feeling
Who uses itolder people, market sellers, and young people with friends
Should I use it?Learn standard Korean first, but knowing some dialect makes people smile

Words you will hear

겁나 geomna = very (매우): 겁나 맛있어! “Super tasty!”

거시기 geosigi = “that thing, you know”: used when you can't think of the word.

징하다 jinghada = too much, amazing or tiresome.

Endings you will hear

-잉 -ing: a soft ending: 그래잉 “OK~”.

-당께 -dangkke = -다니까 “I told you”: 맛있당께!

-허다 -heoda = -하다: 좋아허다.

Feelings

아따 atta and 오메 ome are surprise words like “wow” or “oh my”. You will hear them at the market!

★ For JJ University students 전주대 유학생에게

Try saying 겁나 맛있어요! at a Jeonju restaurant. The owner will laugh and probably give you extra side dishes.
